name: Sapphiron
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/naxxramas/sapphiron.md. The lair is a 60 yd round room, an estimate; only the shape and 'spread like C'Thun' are sourced. HP is a clock: about 5 minutes of ground time plus four air phases, about 6:50 in all (classicdb 2.6M vs wiki 3.16M, kills run 6 to 10 min per the research), so the 15:00 Berserk (Frost Aura x6) is out of reach and not scheduled: noted, not modelled. Damage is scaled to a 10,000 HP tank, so a tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike. Frost Aura is 300 per 2 s on everyone (the real 600 per 2 s halved for about 150 frost resistance plus Greater Frost Protection; the research leaves resistance per raider open and the spell data ('Deals 600 frost damage a second', periodic dummy 601 every 1 second) vs the wiki's and Wowhead's every 2 s is unresolved; the 2 s reading is used, and a later log check should settle the scaling). Melee 850 per 2 s plus Cleave 1,100 is scaled from 10,680-12,258 pre-mitigation so a healer who does nothing loses the tank in about 20 seconds: passive healing with a player healer is 250 per second against about 700 per second incoming (the ghost tank is not hit by Frost Breath, it stands in for the tank hiding like everyone else). Air phase timing is DBM's where it has one: first lift-off 45 s (wiki/WT, DBM Era 31 to 46 s), later lift-off 67 s after landing (DBM 54 to 71 s), landing 28.5 s after lift-off, Frost Breath's cast 12.5 s before landing. The interval between the five Icebolts is not in any source: 2.5 s here is an estimate (the research implies 3 to 4 s and the air phase has about 13 s for all five before the cast). Ice blocks are random players in the real fight; the engine's cover uses fixed named spots, so each air phase has five block spots in a ring around the centre rotated between phases (a generated list, positions and their spread are placeholders). The ranged, healer and melee air spots and the tank's per-phase landing spot (`pickup1` to `pickup4`) are placed clear of every Icebolt splash of that phase. Icebolt lands on those spots as a telegraphed 10 yd hazard, and a green Ice Block circle marks each block. `iceboltYou` (playerChance 0.28, once per air phase, at the fifth bolt so a Chill laid earlier in the phase cannot catch a frozen player who cannot be damaged in the real game) is the Icebolt landing on the player: a stun until the breath lands and full cover from it, which is how the real ice block behaves (immune while frozen); the engine cannot make a frozen player immune to other damage. Icebolt's splash on neighbours is the hazard the others dodge. Frost Breath is 20,000 scaled (real 75,000 to 125,000 Frost, a one-shot either way); cover is a `safeSpots` circle 3 yd behind each block (`coverN_M`, radially away from the bomb's impact point at the hover spot, `safeRadius` 3.5): it accepts from about 0.5 yd in front of the block to 6.5 yd behind it and 3.5 yd to each side, and rejects the side facing the bomb. The engine cannot compute real line of sight, so this is the closest approximation; the wiki rule of moving after the third Icebolt is taught in the tips, not enforced. Life Drain is three copies of a curse per cast (the real spell hits 10 players; the engine has one debuff per action and the three copies keep the dispel decisions honest), 600 per second on the player when it lands (the wiki's 1,750 to 2,250 per 3 s), 12 s; the heal it gives Sapphiron cannot be expressed so it only hurts the raid and is scored as `debuffSeconds`. Mages/Druids decurse: the ranged role carries Dispel (curse only), which is the real assignment. Chill (Blizzard, real 3,063 to 3,907 per 2 s plus a 65% slow) is a stationary telegraphed zone every 12 s on the ground and once per air phase (cadence unknown in the sources, estimate; the air-phase count is low so that it cannot sit on the block a player must hide behind, which the marker cannot avoid) that never roams and does not slow; the engine has no moving hazards and no slow effect. Life Drain's second and third copies only land on non-tank roles so a lone tank player is not drained twice at once; the raid still spends the dispel. Sapphiron cannot be taunted: the tank's Taunt button is relabelled Threat burst and stands for the Heroic Strike and Sunder burst that takes him back after the landing. Landing grabs are scored with `hasAggro`. Whether DPS can keep hitting him in the air: Wowhead says ranged 'can cheat next to the cube', which implies yes, so ranged keep DPS (`attackableInAir`) and melee stand down; the research does not state this outright. Below 10% he stops flying; the script's last air phase is at 21% to 18% and the final phase runs to 0 grounded, so the real 'no air below 10%' rule is met by the clock. Cleave every 7.5 s, Tail Sweep every 11 s (conditional on someone standing behind him) and the 12 yd lift-off knockback radius are estimates; the sources give no cadence.

labels.text: Raid stays clear of the tail

tankSpot.label: Tank: north of him, facing him north

raidGround.label: Raid: east of him, clear of the tail

healerSpot.label: Healers: in range of the tank

boss.looseHint: He cannot be taunted. Burst threat to get him back

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: One tank on Sapphiron, north of him, facing him north so Cleave and his tail stay off the raid. He cannot be taunted: every landing is a threat race. When he flies, be a normal raider: spread, then hide behind an ice block before the breath.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: On his flank, never in front and never in the 30-yard tail cone. In the air spread out, then hide behind a block before Frost Breath lands. Step out of any Chill zone immediately.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Spread east of him and burn him. You are the decursers: Life Drain is a curse and every second it stays up it drains the raid and heals him. In the air, stay spread, then hide behind a block before the breath. Frost spells do nothing to him.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Frost Aura ticks forever, so keep the raid up and the tank above half. Decurse Life Drain the moment it lands. In the air, spread, then hide behind a block; heal only when you are safe.

taunt.label: Threat burst
taunt.tip: Sapphiron cannot be taunted. This button stands for the Heroic Strike and Sunder burst that takes him back after a landing.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Remove Curse. Life Drain is the only curse here. Decurse every target within a few seconds of it landing.

takeoff.label: Takeoff
takeoff.tip: He lifts off. Move out from under him, then spread.

landing.label: Landing
landing.tip: He is down. Tank grabs him, melee back on his flank.

frostAura.label: Frost Aura
frostAura.tip: Frost Aura hits everyone in the room every 2 seconds. It never stops. Frost resistance and potions are the answer.

lifeDrain.label: Life Drain
lifeDrain.tip: Life Drain curses raiders, drains their health and heals him. Decurse every target at once.

lifeDrain2.label: Life Drain
lifeDrain2.tip: Life Drain curses raiders, drains their health and heals him. Decurse every target at once.

lifeDrain3.label: Life Drain
lifeDrain3.tip: Life Drain curses raiders, drains their health and heals him. Decurse every target at once.

cleave.label: Cleave
cleave.raidToast: Cleave hit the raid: turn him away
cleave.tip: A frontal Cleave on the tank. Keep his front off the raid.

tailSweep.label: Tail Sweep
tailSweep.raidToast: Tail Sweep hit the raid: mind his tail
tailSweep.tip: Thirty yards long, 120 degrees wide, behind him. Nobody stands there, ever.

blizzard.label: Chill
blizzard.tip: Chill lands under a random raider and roams. Step out at once: three thousand every 2 seconds and a 65% slow.

liftOff.label: Lift-off
liftOff.tip: He beats his wings and knocks away anyone under him.

iceboltYou.label: Icebolt: frozen
iceboltYou.tip: You are frozen in a block. You cannot move and you are immune to the breath. Everyone else will hide behind you.

blockCover.label: At the ice block
blockCover.tip: You are at an ice block. Only the far side from the centre of the room is out of the line of sight of Frost Breath: stand there until it lands.

icebolt1_1.tip: Icebolt freezes a random raider and hits everyone within 10 yards of them. Spread 10 yards. Never stack on a block until the breath is coming.

iceBlock1_1.label: Ice block
iceBlock1_1.tip: A frozen raider. Stand directly behind this block, on the far side from the centre of the room, and you are out of the line of sight of Frost Breath.

expectations.label: Pull him to the north side and face him north
expectations.tip: Walk him to his spot and keep his breath and Cleave pointing away from the raid. The tail is 30 yards long and points south, so keep the raid at his side.

expectations.label: Hold your spot east of him
expectations.tip: Stay at your spot, spread, out of the tail. Chill moves you, come back.

expectations.label: Stay in range of the tank
expectations.tip: Stay east of him, spread from your group, inside 40 yards of the tank.

expectations.label: Be on his flank when he lifts off
expectations.tip: At his side, behind the forelegs. Never behind the tail and never in front.

expectations.label: Decurse Life Drain at once
expectations.tip: Life Drain pulls health off the raid and heals him. Curse off, every target, within a few seconds of it landing.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Step out of Chill
expectations.tip: A Chill landing under you. Three thousand a second and it slows you. Step out now.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Frost Aura never stops and he hits the tank every 2 seconds. Keep the tank above half.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: A Cleave and two swings on a low tank is a dead tank. Stay ahead.

earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

breathHits.label: Frost Breaths taken in the open
breathHits.tip: A one-shot. Be behind a block before the 7 second cast finishes.

tailed.label: Tail Sweeps taken
tailed.tip: Thirty yards behind him is his tail. Stay at his flank.

cleaveOnRaid.label: Cleaves into the raid
cleaveOnRaid.tip: Face him north, away from everyone.

cues.notes: Grab him on every landing; decurse Life Drain; melee back in after he lands.

list.label: Taunt when Sapphiron turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

list.label: Back on him after he lands
list.tip: Get to his flank and start hitting him again.

drills.name: Frost Breath cover
drills.description: Five Icebolts, then the breath. Find a block after the third bolt and be behind it when the bar finishes.

drills.name: Dodge Chill
drills.description: Chill lands under the raid every few seconds. Step out, then get back to your job.

drills.name: Hold him facing away
drills.description: Cleave and Tail Sweep keep coming. Keep him pointed north and the raid will never see them.

drills.name: Decurse Life Drain
drills.description: Life Drain lands on three raiders every 16 seconds, the raid is taking Frost Aura, and the tank needs a heal after every Cleave.
